title: Shapes
materials: Household rhythm sticks or wooden spoons
quest_mission: Join Vesta & Silas in Terrasol on an acoustic sensory quest to explore Shapes.
rhythm_ignition: Teacher models a steady 2-minute rhythmic call-and-response beat to 'Shapes', synchronizing clapping and vocal chanting with the children.
tactile_ritual:
The Hands-On Sensory Discovery:
1. Children gather in a circle with tactile items.
2. Follow the musical cues of Shapes to touch, sort, and move in rhythmic unison.
3. Pair high-reach movements with deep somatic exhalations.
4. Freeze in quiet stillness at the final chord.

socratic_wonder_circle.rhythm_cue: Three-Beat Detective Knock (95 BPM: Count the Sides — Test the Rule!)
socratic_wonder_circle.wait_time_rule: Hold a calm 4-beat pause after every question before inviting responses.
prompts: Testing Assumptions (S-30): If we tilt a square onto one corner so it looks like a diamond, is it STILL a square? Let's test our song's rule ('four equal sides' and square corners)!
Evaluating Evidence (S-33): How do our fingers prove the difference between a flat circle drawn on paper and a 3D sphere (ball) we can roll across the rug?
Evaluating Theories (S-18): Why do honeybees build hexagons and bridges use triangles—what happens when we gently press on a wooden-stick triangle versus a square?

age_tier_scaffolds.Sprouts (Ages 2–4): Trace round vs. pointy edges with fingers on real household objects.
age_tier_scaffolds.Pathfinders (Ages 4–5): Rotate a square block on its corner and count its 4 equal sides to check if its shape changed.
age_tier_scaffolds.Wayfarers (Ages 6–7): Test structural stability of a triangle vs. square and compare 2D shapes against 3D cubes/spheres.

domain_spider.language: Articulate clear auditory phrasing and target vocabulary connected to Shapes.
domain_spider.cognitive: Identify rhythmic patterns, tempo shifts, and conceptual categories in Terrasol.
domain_spider.physical: Gross motor whole-body balance, bilateral coordination, and fine motor finger rhythm.
domain_spider.science_sensory: Tactile exploration of real-world materials and acoustic auditory pitch discrimination.
domain_spider.social_emotional: Cooperative participation, shared attentional focus, and calming self-regulation.

teacher_whisper: Auditory rhythmic pacing stimulates brainstem regulation and synchronizes attention across the classroom without visual screen fatigue.

standards.kindergarten_readiness: Identifies circles, triangles, rectangles, and hexagons in real-world environments by side and vertex counts.
